user.title: Adaptive Lighting Helpers
user.description: Registers the adaptive_lighting_helpers.compute_lighting_groups, compute_curve, compute_scene_coverage, and apply_lighting services. Nothing else to configure here - add day-phase/curve sensors afterwards from this integration's own page (Add Sensor).

user.title: Add an Adaptive Lighting sensor
user.description: Adds a day-phase/curve sensor and phase-override select, grouped under a device with this name. Entities are prefixed with it too (e.g. "Living Room" -> sensor.living_room_adaptive_lighting). The schedule times and brightness/colour curve aren't set here - they're separate entities on the device once it's created, each starting at a sensible default and adjustable any time.

user.title: Add state device
user.description: A state device tracks which of its lights adaptive lighting is currently driving, and which have been taken over by something else. Point it at an area, a device, or specific lights. A light matching no state device simply isn't tracked.

init.title: Adaptive Lighting Helpers options
init.description:
Bulb models that need two-step transitions, one pattern per line. This is the complete list the check uses — the box starts pre-filled with the models shipped with the integration, and you can add to it or remove from it freely.

Patterns are matched case-insensitively against “manufacturer model”, and * is a wildcard, e.g. *TRADFRI bulb* or IKEA*. Clearing the box entirely falls back to the shipped defaults; to stop being told about unlabelled bulbs, ignore the repair instead.

Once you save your own list it stays as you left it — a later release adding a newly discovered bulb won't change it.
